title: Design System: HoBo Rubberhose

source.note: site/DESIGN.md is the agent-facing contract and stays normative; global.css is the runtime truth. This sidecar carries only what the DESIGN.md frontmatter schema cannot hold — tonal ramps, shadows, motion, breakpoints, and component snippets. It does not duplicate or override token primitives.

defaultTheme.note: Resolved by owner decision: day is the default, night is supported. Bare :root carries the day palette, so the page is ink-on-paper before any script runs and with JavaScript off. Night is opt-in — the toggle, a stored preference, or an OS asking for dark. site/DESIGN.md's frontmatter documents the day values, which now matches the runtime rather than diverging from it.

ink.note: Day/night is an exact inversion pair, not a separate dark palette.

cream.note: Night-mode ink. Also the meadow/pop base.

soot.note: The mascot's body colour; never used as page chrome.

spark.note: Rare interactive accent. See The One Voice Rule — rarity is the point.

display.purpose: Chewy. Display headings only — the Cuphead title-card voice. Never body copy.

body.purpose: system-ui stack. Deliberately plain so the display face carries all the personality.

mono.purpose: Code, CLI transcripts, and technical tables.

shadows.name: sticker-pop
shadows.purpose: Hard offset 'sticker' shadow — the signature depth cue. A flat displaced copy of the silhouette, never a soft blur.

shadows.name: night-lift
shadows.purpose: Night-mode surface lift. The only place a soft shadow is permitted, and only because pure-black offset reads as a hole.

shadows.name: day-lift
shadows.purpose: Day-mode surface lift. Near-invisible by design — depth comes from ink outlines, not elevation.

motion.name: rubberhose-ease
motion.purpose: The squash-and-stretch curve. Overshoots then settles, giving the Fleischer bounce. Must be gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Signage Button
components.description: The signature component: a chamfered wooden trail-sign, not a pill. Zero border-radius with a clip-path silhouette and a hard sticker shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.78rem 1.65rem 0.72rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; clip-path: polygon(3% 0, 97% 0, 100% 50%, 97% 100%, 3% 100%, 0 50%); background: var(--ink, #101010); color: var(--bg, #ffffff); font-family: "Chewy", "Comic Sans MS", cursive; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--pop, rgba(16,16,16,0.85)); transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--pop, rgba(16,16,16,0.85)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--pop, rgba(16,16,16,0.85)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--spark, #c5301c); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ink Card
components.description: Thick-outlined surface with a hard offset shadow. Depth comes from the outline and the displaced copy, never from a blur.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #101010); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #101010); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink, #101010); } .ds-card h3 { font-family: "Chewy", "Comic Sans MS", cursive; margin: 0 0 0.4rem; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Spark Link
components.description: Inline link. Ink by default; spark appears only on interaction, which is the whole budget for colour on a text surface.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--ink, #101010); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--spark, #c5301c); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--spark, #c5301c); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Status Pip
components.description: The only place go-green is allowed. Status, never decoration.
components.css: .ds-pip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #101010); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--go-soft, rgba(20,103,44,0.16)); color: var(--ink, #101010); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; } .ds-pip i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--go, #14672c); }

components.name: Reel Code Block
components.description: CLI transcripts and code. Inset rather than raised — the one surface that recedes.
components.css: .ds-code { margin: 0; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; background: var(--bg-inset, #f4f4f2); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #101010); border-radius: 12px; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-code code { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink, #101010); }

narrative.overview:
HoBo's public site is a 1930s rubberhose cartoon — Steamboat Willie ink-and-paper, Cuphead title cards, Fleischer bounce — not a pastel product dashboard. Everything is ink on paper by day and paper on ink by night (exact theme inversion). Bo the bindlebug is soot-colored with googly eyes; scenery is traced illustration, never generative glop.

Voice is "homeward bound" whimsy with precise technical tables. Agents generating or editing UI must read site/DESIGN.md first and keep every surface on-system.
keyCharacteristics: Rubberhose geometry — pie-cut eyes, sausage limbs, squash-and-stretch motion (honor prefers-reduced-motion).
Thick ink outlines — 2–3px borders; hard sticker offset shadows (not soft Material elevation blobs).
Title-card type — Chewy for display headings; quiet system-ui for body.
Film grain — faint fixed grain overlay; old-reel vibe without muddy contrast.
Strict B&W base — neutrals dominate; spark (vermillion) and go (green) are rare interactive/status accents only — never rainbow chrome.
Traced art only — mascot and scene panels are reference traces (Mascot, scenes/*, parallax plates). Do not invent flat vector substitutes.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Day and night are exact inversion pairs of the same tokens, not two separately-tuned palettes. A token that does not invert cleanly does not belong in the system.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Spark and go are rare interactive and status accents only. Default chrome stays ink and paper. Rarity is what makes them read.

rules.name: The Sticker Rule
rules.body: Depth is a hard offset copy of the silhouette, never a soft blur. If it looks like Material elevation, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Traced Art Rule
rules.body: Mascot and scene panels are reference traces. Do not invent flat vector substitutes, and do not assemble props from rect/line primitives in a renderer — that practice is what produced a rejected build (ADR-0149).

dos: Lead with rubberhose / Steamboat / Cuphead language in new illustrations and motion (bounce, squash, pie eyes).
Keep day/night as inversion pairs of the same tokens.
Trace or reuse existing Bo / scene / plate art.
Put interactive emphasis on spark sparingly; default chrome stays ink/paper.
Validate this file with `pnpm --filter hobo-site run design:lint`.
donts: Don't introduce flat SaaS blues, purples, or multi-stop brand gradients.
Don't replace traced scenes with stock isometric 3D or "AI app" blobs.
Don't thin outlines below ~2px on primary chrome.
Don't soft-blur everything into modern glass UI.
Don't put free-text secrets or live credentials in examples (HoBo policy).
Don't link page prose to raw `docs/design/` repo paths — restate for Pages.

components_note: Synthesized from the project's real tokens per the document reference ("If the project has no component library yet, synthesize canonical primitives from the tokens"). These ds-* classes are not present in site/ — they are renderable exemplars of the system, not extracts of shipped markup. Every var() they use is a real runtime variable in site/src/styles/global.css, so they invert correctly with the theme.
